title: Lead RRP work practice standards practice questions
description: Free Lead RRP work practice questions on 40 CFR 745.85: signs, interior and exterior containment, waste and cleaning. Every answer is explained and sourced.

questions.topic: Who does the work and warning signs
questions.question: Under 745.85(a)(1), until when must the warning signs remain in place and readable?

options.A: Until the end of each work day
options.B: Until the renovation work itself is finished
options.C: Until the renovation and the post-renovation cleaning verification have been completed
options.D: Until all waste has been removed from the property

questions.explanation: The signs "must be posted before beginning the renovation and must remain in place and readable until the renovation and the post-renovation cleaning verification have been completed."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: must remain in place and readable until the renovation and the post-renovation cleaning verification have been completed

questions.topic: Who does the work and warning signs
questions.question: According to 745.85(a)(1), when are additional signs not required by that section?

options.A: When warning signs have been posted in accordance with 24 CFR 35.1345(b)(2) or 29 CFR 1926.62(m)
options.B: When the occupants have received the lead hazard information pamphlet
options.C: When the renovation is limited to exterior surfaces
options.D: When the occupants have agreed in writing to stay out of the work area

questions.explanation: "If warning signs have been posted in accordance with 24 CFR 35.1345(b)(2) or 29 CFR 1926.62(m), additional signs are not required by this section."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: If warning signs have been posted in accordance with 24 CFR 35.1345(b)(2) or 29 CFR 1926.62(m), additional signs are not required by this section.

questions.question: Before beginning the renovation, what result must the firm's isolation of the work area achieve under 745.85(a)(2)?

options.A: Dust-lead levels outside the work area stay below the dust-lead action levels
options.B: Occupants cannot see into the work area
options.C: Any dust that leaves the work area is HEPA-vacuumed by the end of the day
options.D: No dust or debris leaves the work area while the renovation is being performed

questions.explanation: "Before beginning the renovation, the firm must isolate the work area so that no dust or debris leaves the work area while the renovation is being performed."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: the firm must isolate the work area so that no dust or debris leaves the work area while the renovation is being performed

questions.question: What does 745.85(a)(2) require of containment with respect to emergencies?

options.A: It must be made of fire-rated sheeting
options.B: It must be installed so that it does not interfere with occupant and worker egress in an emergency
options.C: It must be taken down whenever occupants are in the dwelling
options.D: It must include a posted emergency evacuation map

questions.explanation: "The firm must also ensure that containment is installed in such a manner that it does not interfere with occupant and worker egress in an emergency."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: containment is installed in such a manner that it does not interfere with occupant and worker egress in an emergency

questions.question: For an interior renovation, what must the firm do with objects in the work area such as furniture, rugs and window coverings?

options.A: Leave them in place, because the floor covering protects them
options.B: Remove them, or cover them with plastic sheeting or other impermeable material with all seams and edges taped or otherwise sealed
options.C: Remove them; covering them in place is not allowed
options.D: Cover them with cloth drop sheets

questions.explanation: The firm must "Remove all objects from the work area, including furniture, rugs, and window coverings, or cover them with plastic sheeting or other impermeable material with all seams and edges taped or otherwise sealed."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: Remove all objects from the work area, including furniture, rugs, and window coverings, or cover them with plastic sheeting or other impermeable material with all seams and edges taped or otherwise sealed.

questions.question: What does 745.85(a)(2)(i)(B) require for ducts opening in the work area of an interior renovation?

options.A: Run the HVAC fan continuously to pull dust out of the room
options.B: Fit each duct opening with a HEPA filter
options.C: Close them only if the heating or cooling system will be running
options.D: Close and cover them with taped-down plastic sheeting or other impermeable material

questions.explanation: The firm must "Close and cover all ducts opening in the work area with taped-down plastic sheeting or other impermeable material."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: Close and cover all ducts opening in the work area with taped-down plastic sheeting or other impermeable material.

questions.question: On an interior renovation, when may floor containment stop at the edge of the vertical barrier?

options.A: When using a vertical containment system of impermeable barriers that extend from the floor to the ceiling and are tightly sealed at joints with the floor, ceiling and walls
options.B: When the floor has installed carpet
options.C: When the doors to the work area are closed and covered
options.D: When the floor area of the work area is smaller than 40 square feet

questions.explanation: "Floor containment measures may stop at the edge of the vertical barrier when using a vertical containment system consisting of impermeable barriers that extend from the floor to the ceiling and are tightly sealed at joints with the floor, ceiling and walls." The floor covering itself must cover "the floor surface, including installed carpet."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: Floor containment measures may stop at the edge of the vertical barrier when using a vertical containment system consisting of impermeable barriers that extend from the floor to the ceiling and are tightly sealed at joints with the floor, ceiling and walls.

questions.question: What distance does 745.85(a)(2)(ii)(A) set for closing doors and windows around an exterior renovation?

options.A: 6 feet
options.B: 10 feet
options.C: 20 feet
options.D: 2 feet

questions.explanation: For exterior renovations the firm must "Close all doors and windows within 20 feet of the renovation."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: Close all doors and windows within 20 feet of the renovation.

questions.question: For an exterior renovation on a multi-story building, which doors and windows on the floors below must the firm close?

options.A: None; only the floor of the renovation is affected
options.B: Only those directly beneath the surfaces being renovated
options.C: Every door and window in the building
options.D: All doors and windows on all floors below that are the same horizontal distance from the renovation

questions.explanation: The firm must "close all doors and windows on all floors below that are the same horizontal distance from the renovation."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: close all doors and windows on all floors below that are the same horizontal distance from the renovation

questions.question: Which condition does 745.85(a)(2)(ii)(D) name as requiring the firm to erect vertical containment or equivalent extra precautions?

options.A: The renovation will affect surfaces within 10 feet of the property line
options.B: The building has more than one story
options.C: A heat gun will be used on painted surfaces
options.D: The ground covering extends more than 10 feet

questions.explanation: "If the renovation will affect surfaces within 10 feet of the property line, the renovation firm must erect vertical containment or equivalent extra precautions in containing the work area."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: If the renovation will affect surfaces within 10 feet of the property line, the renovation firm must erect vertical containment or equivalent extra precautions in containing the work area

questions.question: On an exterior renovation, how must doors within the work area that will be used while the job is being performed be treated?

options.A: Locked and kept unused until cleaning verification is complete
options.B: Covered with plastic sheeting or other impermeable material in a manner that allows workers to pass through while confining dust and debris to the work area
options.C: Left open for ventilation
options.D: Taped shut with no way for workers to pass through

questions.explanation: The firm must "Ensure that doors within the work area that will be used while the job is being performed are covered with plastic sheeting or other impermeable material in a manner that allows workers to pass through while confining dust and debris to the work area."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: Ensure that doors within the work area that will be used while the job is being performed are covered with plastic sheeting or other impermeable material in a manner that allows workers to pass through while confining dust and debris to the work area.

questions.question: Under 745.85(a)(3)(ii), on what condition may machines that remove paint through high-speed operation, such as sanding or grinding, be used on painted surfaces?

options.A: When the surface is misted with water first
options.B: When the workers wear respirators
options.C: When the machines have shrouds or containment systems and are equipped with a HEPA vacuum attachment to collect dust and debris at the point of generation
options.D: When they are used only on exterior surfaces

questions.explanation: Such machines are "prohibited on painted surfaces unless such machines have shrouds or containment systems and are equipped with a HEPA vacuum attachment to collect dust and debris at the point of generation."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: is prohibited on painted surfaces unless such machines have shrouds or containment systems and are equipped with a HEPA vacuum attachment to collect dust and debris at the point of generation

questions.question: If a chute is used to remove waste from the work area, what does 745.85(a)(4)(i) require?

options.A: The chute must be covered
options.B: The chute must have a HEPA exhaust fan
options.C: The chute must be misted after each load
options.D: The chute must be used only at the end of the work day

questions.explanation: "If a chute is used to remove waste from the work area, it must be covered."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: If a chute is used to remove waste from the work area, it must be covered.

questions.question: When does 745.85(a)(4)(ii) require collected renovation waste to be stored under containment, in an enclosure, or behind a barrier?

options.A: Only at the conclusion of the renovation
options.B: Only while the firm is transporting it
options.C: Only when occupants remain in the dwelling during the work
options.D: At the conclusion of each work day and at the conclusion of the renovation

questions.explanation: "At the conclusion of each work day and at the conclusion of the renovation, waste that has been collected from renovation activities must be stored under containment, in an enclosure, or behind a barrier."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: At the conclusion of each work day and at the conclusion of the renovation, waste that has been collected from renovation activities must be stored under containment, in an enclosure, or behind a barrier

questions.question: During cleaning of the work area, when may sheeting used to isolate contaminated rooms from non-contaminated rooms be removed?

options.A: Before any other sheeting is removed
options.B: Only after the cleaning and removal of other sheeting
options.C: At the end of the last work day, before cleaning starts
options.D: As soon as paint chips have been bagged

questions.explanation: "Sheeting used to isolate contaminated rooms from non-contaminated rooms must remain in place until after the cleaning and removal of other sheeting."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: Sheeting used to isolate contaminated rooms from non-contaminated rooms must remain in place until after the cleaning and removal of other sheeting.

questions.question: For interior renovations, what distance beyond the work area does 745.85(a)(5)(ii) set for cleaning all objects and surfaces?

options.A: 6 feet
options.B: 10 feet
options.C: 2 feet
options.D: 20 feet

questions.explanation: "The firm must clean all objects and surfaces in the work area and within 2 feet of the work area in the following manner, cleaning from higher to lower."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: The firm must clean all objects and surfaces in the work area and within 2 feet of the work area in the following manner, cleaning from higher to lower

questions.question: For interior renovations, how does 745.85(a)(5)(ii)(C) require uncarpeted floors to be mopped?

options.A: Using a mopping method that keeps the wash water separate from the rinse water, such as the 2-bucket mopping method, or using a wet mopping system
options.B: Using a single bucket of detergent solution changed once a day
options.C: Dry sweeping first, then one pass with a damp mop
options.D: They are not mopped; HEPA vacuuming alone is required

questions.explanation: "Mop uncarpeted floors thoroughly, using a mopping method that keeps the wash water separate from the rinse water, such as the 2-bucket mopping method, or using a wet mopping system."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: Mop uncarpeted floors thoroughly, using a mopping method that keeps the wash water separate from the rinse water, such as the 2-bucket mopping method, or using a wet mopping system.

questions.topic: Dust clearance testing and later activities
questions.question: Under 745.85(c), in which situation need cleaning verification not be performed?

options.A: When the occupants sign a waiver of cleaning verification
options.B: When the renovation is limited to exterior surfaces
options.C: When the certified renovator sees no dust or debris during a visual inspection
options.D: When the contract or another Federal, State, Territorial, Tribal, or local law or regulation requires the firm to perform dust clearance sampling collected by a certified inspector, risk assessor or dust sampling technician, and to re-clean until results are below the applicable dust-lead action levels

questions.explanation: "Cleaning verification need not be performed if the contract between the renovation firm and the person contracting for the renovation or another Federal, State, Territorial, Tribal, or local law or regulation requires" dust clearance sampling, collection "by a certified inspector, risk assessor or dust sampling technician", and re-cleaning until results "are below the dust-lead action levels in § 745.227(e)(8) or any applicable State, Territorial, Tribal, or local standard."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: Cleaning verification need not be performed if the contract between the renovation firm and the person contracting for the renovation or another Federal, State, Territorial, Tribal, or local law or regulation requires

questions.topic: Dust clearance testing and later activities
questions.question: Under the optional dust clearance testing in 745.85(c)(2), who must the dust clearance samples be required to be collected by?

options.A: The certified renovator assigned to the project
options.B: A worker trained by the certified renovator
options.C: A certified inspector, risk assessor or dust sampling technician
options.D: The person contracting for the renovation

questions.explanation: "The dust clearance samples are required to be collected by a certified inspector, risk assessor or dust sampling technician."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: The dust clearance samples are required to be collected by a certified inspector, risk assessor or dust sampling technician.

questions.topic: Dust clearance testing and later activities
questions.question: Under 745.85(d), which activities conducted after post-renovation cleaning verification has been performed are not regulated by Subpart E?

options.A: Any activity performed within 30 days of the renovation
options.B: Activities that do not disturb paint, such as applying paint to walls that have already been prepared
options.C: Sanding walls with a shrouded sander equipped with a HEPA vacuum attachment
options.D: Removing painted trim from the same room

questions.explanation: "Activities that do not disturb paint, such as applying paint to walls that have already been prepared, are not regulated by this subpart if they are conducted after post-renovation cleaning verification has been performed."

source.title: eCFR: 40 CFR 745.85, Work practice standards (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.evidence: Activities that do not disturb paint, such as applying paint to walls that have already been prepared, are not regulated by this subpart if they are conducted after post-renovation cleaning verification has been performed.
